description: Search inventory records using a combination of call number range, title, subject, material type, subtype, campus, and department filters. Results include items that match the selected criteria.
instructions: Enter any combination of search criteria to locate inventory items. Optional filters: Call Number Range (Start/End), Title and Search Type, Subjects (use OR between terms; use - to exclude a term), Material Type, Subtype, Campus, Department. Leave a field blank or select All to include all values for that filter.
